figurative_meaning_en: Someone who loves to sleep very much
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে একটা ঘুম কাতর লোক, সকালে উঠতেই চায় না।
আমার ভাই ঘুম কাতর, সারাদিন ঘুমিয়ে কাটায়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is a real sleepyhead; he doesn't want to get up in the morning.
My brother loves to sleep so much that he spends the whole day napping.
note: The idiom reflects a light-hearted cultural observation on sleep preferences in Bengali daily life.
